item.title: Ask HN: How do you keep up with HN these days?
item.summary: In the last 2-3 years, mostly because of AI, keeping up with interesting articles on HN has become harder and harder. How do you deal with it? Besides the simple solution of simply ignoring interesting stuff more and more. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49308059 Points: 11 # Comments: 8
